div.div:
PII / authority boundary
• Git contains source and approved release ZIPs only
• Secure File contains the protected recipient cohort
• Access is limited to release operators
• Azure DevOps validates, batches and publishes snapshots
• Pipeline cannot call SendGrid
• The email list never grants download access

div.div:
Database-free authorization + download
1. Open the stable release URL
2. Container Apps authentication redirects to Microsoft Entra ID
3. Platform validates the returned identity token
4. App receives the validated subject
5. App selects {version}/{filename} and pins its ETag
6. App streams with If-Match and emits audit events

div.div: Email and the recipient cohort never grant access. Microsoft Entra ID and Container Apps authentication own authentication; the Go app has no SQL connection. Session and revocation behavior follows the configured identity policy. A completed audit event means the server streamed all release bytes—not proof the file was saved or opened.
